Questions

The things teams ask us most before switching.

Can we import from our current tracker?

Yes — Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues and CSV imports all preserve history, comments and attachments.

Is there a self-hosted option?

Enterprise plans can run Meridian in your own VPC with the same release cadence as our cloud.

How does pricing work for contractors?

Guest seats are free for anyone outside your organization who only comments on issues.
